inputs.text: This ruling shows how the system can protect people it has already decided to shield: even serious allegations and stolen articles that haven’t been recovered apparently don’t undo pre-arrest bail. The court’s demand for clear proof of misuse or new circumstances sounds like a neutral rule, but it creates a high bar that keeps cases from advancing against the protected. That isn’t just procedure—it’s institutional cover, and the narrow standard looks designed to make it harder to challenge.
